def binary_search(arr, x):
    lo, hi = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if arr[mid] == x: return mid
        elif arr[mid] < x: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return -1   # not found
